description: Hoist tenantScopedTable, publishRmmSyncEvent, axiosErrorToMessage from tacticalrmm/deviceSync.ts into lib/rmm/common/ with re-exports (no behavior change).
Hoist software_catalog/asset_software upsert helpers out of tacticalRmmActions.ts into lib/rmm/common/softwareInventory.ts.
CE RMM tab renders provider picker from getAvailableRmmProviderRegistry({isEnterprise:false}) instead of hardcoding Tactical; ?rmmProvider deep link preserved.
Grep migrations/seeds for provider CHECK constraints or enums listing tacticalrmm; add 'datto' where required.
Register 'datto' in providerRegistry (requiresEnterprise:false, icon 'datto'), display name 'Datto RMM', ticketCreator label, reserved inbound webhook slugs 'datto'/'datto_rmm'.

DattoRmmClient: platform URL normalization, OAuth password-grant token fetch with cached token+expiry in tenant secrets, 401 re-auth once, 429 Retry-After backoff, nextPageUrl pagination, request counter.
buildDattoClientForTenant reads rmm_integrations(provider='datto') + secrets; returns null when inactive.

Server actions: getDattoRmmSettings (masked), saveDattoRmmConfiguration, testDattoRmmConnection (account + sites probe, 403 permission hint), disconnectDattoRmmIntegration (clear secrets, keep mappings, cancel jobs), getDattoRmmConnectionSummary.
DattoRmmIntegrationSettings connection + status sections; picker wiring and DRMM chip in RmmIntegrationsSetup.
Mark integration reconnectRequired on persistent 401 so job gates skip it.
syncDattoRmmSites upserts rmm_organization_mappings from /v2/account/sites with autotask metadata.
Suggested client match by autotaskCompanyName then site name (case-insensitive exact); suggestion only.
Site mapping table UI reusing ClientPicker, ContactPicker default contact, billing profile, auto-sync, client-change dialog, user/contact mapping panel.
mappers.ts: Datto Device -> NormalizedRmmExternalDeviceSnapshot (type, status, lifecycle, extension fields, systemInfo extras).
Audit enrichment (serial, make/model, CPU, RAM, disks) only when lastAuditDate changed; printer/esxi audit endpoints by deviceClass.
runDattoRmmDeviceSync full/incremental via ingestNormalizedRmmDeviceSnapshot per auto-sync site; external entity mappings integration_type='datto'; vanished devices left in place.
dattoRmmDeviceSyncStrategy registered in rmm-device-sync job (non-@enterprise import); 'datto' added to RMM_DEVICE_SYNC_PROVIDERS; throws on unsuccessful run.
syncDattoSingleDeviceForTenant + syncDattoRmmDevices / syncDattoRmmSingleDevice actions; Devices section UI with shared RmmDeviceSyncSettings.
package.json exports subpaths for datto modules consumed by packages/jobs and server routes.
mapDattoAlertToEvent (priority->severity, epoch ms, conditionIdentity from @class + monitor info, site/device ids).
dattoRmmAlertFetcher registered (side effect + ensureFetchersRegistered); 'datto' in RMM_ALERT_POLLING_PROVIDERS; filtered to mapped sites.
backfillDattoRmmAlerts action + Alerts section UI (polling toggle, Sync Alerts).

Webhook route /api/webhooks/datto: tenant + header secret (constant-time), rmm_webhook_events dedupe, fetch authoritative alert, process, single-device refresh, suspended-tenant 200 no-op; middleware exact skip path.
getDattoRmmWebhookInfo: URL, generated secret, JSON body template with Datto placeholders.
ingestDattoRmmSoftwareInventory with concurrency limit and lastAuditDate skip, via common softwareInventory helper.

dattoRmmAssetDeviceActions (refresh, remoteControlTypes/Url via webRemoteUrl, reboot via configured component, runScript quick job) wired in resolveRmmAssetDeviceActions; RemoteAccessButton providerTypes.
Asset actions settings: reboot component UID + listDattoRmmComponents lookup (graceful on 403).
Outbound adapter: resolve Datto alert on linked ticket close, behind settings toggle (default off).
Admin guide docs/integrations/datto-rmm.md mirroring tactical-rmm.md.
